extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: double-ended subway car with round tube profile, 18.0 m over couplers, 2.85 m wide, 3.8 m high, standard gauge 1435 mm
extras.notes: front faces -Y (both ends have a cab), origin on the rail top (wheel contact plane); centre couplers 1.05 m above rail top (Cozy Trains kit standard); third rail collector shoes on both bogies; doors are part of the body (not separate); bogies with wheelsets are part of the mesh (no moving parts); emissive lights, opaque tinted windows, no interior, no lettering or route numbers

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
